text:
alex: Heads-up — staging promote stuck. deploybot reported cache-index hash mismatch for artifact shard 17, and the staging smoke test shows intermittent failures.

deploybot: promote task 2026-09-03-17 paused — reason: cache-hash mismatch on shard 17. Manual action required: pin to known-good digest or reupload.

ci-bot: smoke-test-suite: failed 2 of 3 runs. Failing test: tests/integration/test-auth-seed.py::test_seed_idempotency
ci-bot: log snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 200 but got 503
... redis connection timeout during fixture setup
```

maya: Ugh. Did we push any infra-related changes that touch the seeding logic? @ben

ben: No app code change in this rollout. Looks like the artifact verifier bumped the cache algorithm in the staging mirror last night. Change window ends in ~25m.

maya: Options: (1) pin promote to last-good digest, (2) reupload artifact (slow), (3) rollback staging to previous deployment. I'm leaning to pin so we don't block prod change window.

sre-oncall: If we pin, increase cache-validate retries (to avoid transient ETAG flaps) and watch redis pool. I can open a quick metric alert for redis connection errors.

alex: I vote pin as well. Plan: ben does manual promote to digest sha256:abcd1234, run smoke, if green we continue; if smoke still flaky, rollback to last-stable tag and re-evaluate.

ben: Running manual promote now:
> deploybot promote --environment=staging --artifact-digest=sha256:abcd1234 --force-manual

deploybot: Received manual promote request. Verifying digest ... verify ok. Promoting to staging.

ci-bot: running smoke tests (1/3) ...
ci-bot: running smoke tests (2/3) ...
ci-bot: running smoke tests (3/3) ... all passed :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Promote complete. staging now at sha256:abcd1234. No regressions detected.

maya: Great. I'll update release notes and mark the promote unblocked. Will also add follow-up ticket to investigate the mirror cache algorithm bump.

alex: Thanks everyone. We'll leave the redis alert on for 1 hour.

sre-oncall: alert on, monitoring.
